narrative.overview: A bright premium café identity grounded in Krushna raspberry and ivory, with wine-dark cinematic moments, warm food photography and an editorial serif voice. The interface stays welcoming for families while using disciplined spacing, restrained controls and large storytelling images.
keyCharacteristics: Krushna's Heaven remains the unmistakable parent brand.
Five experiences share one ordered visual and navigation system.
Fraunces headlines bring editorial character; Karla keeps practical content clear.
Dark cinematic fields are reserved for story moments, not every section.
Mobile is a deliberate stacked and swipeable experience.

rules.name: Parent brand first
rules.body: Mr Gelato appears only inside the Premium Gelatos context.

rules.name: Photography carries appetite
rules.body: Use large warm crops and avoid decorative card clutter.

rules.name: Facts before conversion
rules.body: Do not activate contact or directions actions until their details are verified.

rules.name: Motion serves sequence
rules.body: Keep routine feedback short and reserve cinematic pacing for hero and chapter storytelling.

dos: Use raspberry, wine and ivory as one connected brand world.
Keep live headings and actions independent from image or video media.
Preserve focus, keyboard, reduced-motion and touch behavior.
Identify illustrative photography and provisional business facts.
donts: Do not reintroduce the Mr Gelato-first identity or pint builder.
Do not invent contact details, claims, ratings, facilities or preparation facts.
Do not compress the five desktop panels into unreadable mobile columns.
Do not use glassmorphism, neon gradients or decorative dashboard cards.
